description: Angular component for a usage info widget in the Thingsboard UI, managing display of usage statistics and critical thresholds.

classes.name: UsageInfoWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending PageComponent, responsible for displaying usage information and critical thresholds.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, checks user authority, fetches usage info, and updates critical status indicators.

methods.name: maxValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted maximum value or infinity symbol.

methods.name: progressValue
methods.description: Calculates percentage progress based on value and max.

methods.name: isItemCritical
methods.description: Determines if a usage item is critical based on threshold.
